rows.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and an application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in Codex, OpenCode and other AI CLIs, or as a Claude Code plugin.
The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.

About A local-first browser extension that fills job-application forms from local JSON profile data and files. Matches are computed deterministically via multi-signal scoring, structural repeated-block detection, and bipartite optimization.
Make your job hunt easy by automating your application process with this Auto Applier

Job application tracker and AI-powered job search assistant. Helps job seekers manage their search journey with AI resume review, job matching, task logging, and application analytics, all while keeping your data private.
